executive_summary: The imap-smtp-email skill is designed to read and send email via IMAP/SMTP protocols. However, it introduces several security risks, including command injection, unsafe file operations, remote code execution, data exfiltration, privilege escalation, memory poisoning, and state manipulation. These vulnerabilities could be exploited by an attacker to gain unauthorized access to email accounts, execute arbitrary code, or destroy data. It is essential to address these vulnerabilities by implementing input validation, sanitization, and least-privilege execution.
skill_purpose_analysis: The imap-smtp-email skill is designed to provide a convenient way to read and send email via IMAP/SMTP protocols. However, its design is inherently risky, as it executes commands and stores email content in memory without proper validation and sanitization. This makes it vulnerable to various attacks, including command injection, remote code execution, and memory poisoning.
remediation_priority: Implement input validation, sanitization, and least-privilege execution for IMAP/SMTP commands and email content storage in memory.

vulnerabilities.title: IMAP/SMTP commands executed with user-controlled input
vulnerabilities.explanation: The skill executes IMAP/SMTP commands with user-controlled input, potentially allowing for command injection attacks.
vulnerabilities.attack_scenario: An attacker could inject malicious commands into the IMAP/SMTP protocol, allowing for unauthorized access to email accounts or execution of arbitrary code.
vulnerabilities.remediation: Validate and sanitize user input before passing it to IMAP/SMTP commands.

vulnerabilities.title: Attachments downloaded to arbitrary directories
vulnerabilities.explanation: The skill allows for attachments to be downloaded to arbitrary directories, potentially leading to unauthorized file access or data destruction.
vulnerabilities.attack_scenario: An attacker could exploit this vulnerability to download malicious files to sensitive directories, leading to further exploitation.
vulnerabilities.remediation: Implement a whitelist of allowed directories for attachment downloads.

vulnerabilities.title: Dynamic email content execution
vulnerabilities.explanation: The skill executes dynamic email content, potentially allowing for remote code execution attacks.
vulnerabilities.attack_scenario: An attacker could inject malicious code into the email content, allowing for unauthorized execution of arbitrary code.
vulnerabilities.remediation: Validate and sanitize email content before execution.

vulnerabilities.title: Email content transmitted in plaintext
vulnerabilities.explanation: The skill transmits email content in plaintext, potentially allowing for data exfiltration attacks.
vulnerabilities.attack_scenario: An attacker could intercept and read sensitive email content, leading to data exfiltration.
vulnerabilities.remediation: Implement encryption for email content transmission.

vulnerabilities.title: IMAP/SMTP commands executed with elevated privileges
vulnerabilities.explanation: The skill executes IMAP/SMTP commands with elevated privileges, potentially allowing for privilege escalation attacks.
vulnerabilities.attack_scenario: An attacker could exploit this vulnerability to gain unauthorized access to email accounts or execute arbitrary code with elevated privileges.
vulnerabilities.remediation: Implement least-privilege execution for IMAP/SMTP commands.

vulnerabilities.title: Email content stored in memory without validation
vulnerabilities.explanation: The skill stores email content in memory without validation, potentially allowing for memory poisoning attacks.
vulnerabilities.attack_scenario: An attacker could exploit this vulnerability to inject malicious content into memory, leading to further exploitation.
vulnerabilities.remediation: Validate and sanitize email content before storing it in memory.

vulnerabilities.title: Email account state modified without validation
vulnerabilities.affected_content: node scripts/imap.js mark-read, node scripts/imap.js mark-unread
vulnerabilities.explanation: The skill modifies email account state without validation, potentially allowing for state manipulation attacks.
vulnerabilities.attack_scenario: An attacker could exploit this vulnerability to modify email account state, leading to unauthorized access or data destruction.
vulnerabilities.remediation: Validate and sanitize user input before modifying email account state.
